data.desc: Keel is a North American digital infrastructure and energy company that develops and owns data centers and energy infrastructure for high-performance computing workloads, including AI. With a development pipeline of 2.2 gigawatts and established grid interconnections in place, Keel delivers scalable infrastructure solutions in high-demand power markets across Pennsylvania and Washington State in the United States, and Quebec in Canada. Keel is headquartered in New York City and trades under the ticker symbol 'KEEL' on Nasdaq and TSX. Learn more at www.keelinfra.com.
